Gavriel mentioned having particular difficulty with the final boss in "Octopath Traveler." He noted that it took him multiple attempts to find the right strategy and adapt to the character moves effectively. The final boss encounter was highlighted as a challenging and frustrating part of the game for him, indicating that it was one of the toughest boss fights for Gavriel in the game. His experience suggests that this boss provided a significant test of his planning and strategic approaches throughout the game.

> "I struggled a lot with the final boss! It took me multiple tries to figure out the right strategy. Switching characters and adapting to their moves was key."

This feedback from Gavriel points to the complexity and the substantial challenge posed by the final boss, which seemed to require a good deal of study and patience to conquer. Despite the trouble, the experience gained from engaging with such a demanding adversary contributed to his growth as a player within the game's world, ultimately leading to his triumph.
